meta.title: How the AI works | Expensum
meta.description: Transparency on the AI models used by Expensum, in line with the AI Act.

ComeFunzionaMoneo.title: How the AI works
ComeFunzionaMoneo.intro: Expensum’s AI assistant helps you read and organize your financial data. Here you’ll find which models we use, what we use them for, and their limitations, in line with the transparency obligations of the AI Act (EU Regulation 2024/1689, Art. 50).

aiDisclosure.title: You are talking to an artificial intelligence
aiDisclosure.desc: Every response from the assistant, whether in the messages you receive, in the web chat, or in monthly and weekly reports, is generated automatically by a language model (LLM), not by a person. We always disclose this at the first interaction and in every report.

models.title: The AI models we use

items.name: Expense reading model
items.purpose: Reads and categorizes expenses you write or photograph (receipts).

items.name: Conversation model
items.purpose: Conversation with the assistant in chat: answers your questions about your finances.

items.name: Voice transcription model
items.purpose: Transcribes voice messages into text, before expense analysis.

models.footnote: All models used for text and photo analysis are provided by a European AI provider compliant with GDPR. The voice transcription model is used only to transcribe voice messages, exclusively for PRO users.

limits.title: Known limitations
limits.desc: The AI assistant can make mistakes: wrong categories, amounts misread from a hard-to-read receipt, or inaccurate voice transcriptions. Always verify important financial data before making decisions based on reports or its answers. You can correct any expense or income entry at any time.

MutuoCalculator.title: Mortgage/loan calculator
MutuoCalculator.intro: Enter your details to estimate the monthly installment and the APR. This is indicative only: your bank will apply its final terms.

fields.tanHelper: The nominal annual rate communicated by the bank: drives the installment calculation.
fields.originationFeeHelper: One-off fee charged when the loan is opened.
fields.monthlyFeeHelper: Fixed recurring fee charged with every installment.

results.title: Estimate
results.disclaimer: The APR shown is an estimate calculated by Expensum from the additional costs entered: it does not replace the official one shown by the bank in its disclosure sheet.
